metadata.source: Sysmagine/SemanticDiff public GitHub issues and scopes documentation

statuses.covered: IntentumDiff supports it and has a deterministic regression test.
statuses.partial: IntentumDiff has support, but the exact issue-inspired case is not locked.
statuses.gap: IntentumDiff does not support it yet; backlog item required.
statuses.not_planned: Explicit product decision to avoid or defer.

beta_policies.required: Must be covered or partially supported before 0.0.1 beta.
beta_policies.deferred_surface: Separate product surface explicitly deferred by product policy.

proof_strengths.exact_regression: A deterministic issue-shaped test or fixture directly covers the competitor issue theme.
proof_strengths.feature_contract: A narrower product contract is tested, but exact issue-shaped proof is still tracked for beta hardening.
proof_strengths.release_verifier: Release workflow, package verifier, or CI artifact evidence proves the claim.
proof_strengths.visual_proof_needed: Code/test support exists, but final beta acceptance also requires approved screenshot or media proof.

implementation_owners.rust_core: Behavior is implemented in the native Rust core and exposed through the Python layer.
implementation_owners.rust_wasm_parser: Behavior depends on first-party Rust Wasm parser crates and parser telemetry.
implementation_owners.python_shell: Behavior is intentionally owned by the thin Python orchestration layer.
implementation_owners.vscode_ui: Behavior is owned by the VS Code extension UI or command surface.
implementation_owners.release: Behavior is owned by release/package/build verification.
implementation_owners.product_policy: Behavior is an explicit product-scope decision rather than implemented beta functionality.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff's native Rust Python engine attaches scope trails to public diff metadata, and VS Code renders semantic hunk breadcrumb chips with clickable context targets in the custom diff.
regression_tests: plugins/vscode/test/reviewWebviewModel.test.ts::panel renders scope breadcrumbs and optional hidden Unicode markers
entries.next_action: Keep broad non-Python engine ancestry metadata as future depth work; beta scope breadcrumbs are deterministic for Python and safely rendered in VS Code.

entries.intentumdiff_position: Release workflow and verifier require a Windows ARM64 (`win_arm64`) wheel, giving IntentumDiff a first-release ARM lane.
entries.next_action: Run the normal GitHub Actions release matrix and smoke test win_arm64 on real Windows ARM64 hardware when available.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff ships built-in parser coverage for these language requests and keeps language smoke coverage in tests.
entries.next_action: Keep exact issue-shaped fixtures for the most valuable parser edge cases.

entries.intentumdiff_position: GraphQL, OCaml/ReasonML, LaTeX, PO/gettext, and AsciiDoc resolve through first-party parser entrypoints and preserve their requested language identity instead of falling back to a generic language id.
entries.next_action: Replace lightweight full-parse entrypoints with deeper grammars as demand justifies, keeping issue-shaped fixtures for each upgrade.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff has C/C++ parser support plus issue-shaped coverage for preprocessor macro value edits, larger function move evidence, and compile_commands.json context metadata.
entries.next_action: Keep C/C++ macro/template, large-move, and compile-command release-depth proof in the RC gate while expanding macro/preprocessor strategy with larger fixtures.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff supports JSON/YAML/config parsing, schema metadata, and suppresses unchanged keyed reorders while keeping value edits visible.
entries.next_action: Keep adding schema-specific config fixtures as new profiles ship.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff supports Java, C#, JS, TS, and TSX with issue-shaped fixtures for import/annotation reorder, C# async identifiers, and JavaScript semicolon insertion.
entries.next_action: Keep extending exact syntax fixtures as upstream parser grammars evolve.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff supports CSS and SCSS with issue-shaped fixtures for attribute selectors and SCSS @use alias/value changes.
entries.next_action: Keep broader web-format parser fixtures in the integration suite.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff has live buffer and unsupported-file fallback paths.
entries.next_action: Keep live-buffer and unsupported-file behaviour in the release gate.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff custom diff supports grouped review, hidden context, toolbar actions, next/previous navigation, minimap/folding, responsive layout, and scope hunk chips.
regression_tests: plugins/vscode/test/reviewWebviewModel.test.ts::panel model collapses uninteresting blank inserted rows behind gutter controls
plugins/vscode/test/reviewWebviewModel.test.ts::panel renders scope breadcrumbs and optional hidden Unicode markers
entries.next_action: Refresh screenshots and GIFs after the final UX review.
entries.proof_target: Phase 4 screenshot: Semantic Diff with minimap, folding, scope chips, horizontal scroll, and narrow pane

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff contributes theme colours, dedicated light/dark toolbar icons, and light/high-contrast defaults for semantic review colours.
entries.next_action: Capture dark/light screenshots during final media refresh; manifest and icon contrast contracts are locked.
entries.proof_target: Phase 4 screenshot: light theme plus dark theme icon/color contrast

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff keeps native VS Code diff/SCM workflows available for edit and file-level stage/revert, with custom review actions always linking back to native diff when mutation is needed.
regression_tests: plugins/vscode/test/themeColors.test.ts::extension contributes Timeline, stage, and revert review surfaces
entries.next_action: Design semantic block stage/revert as a future explicit editing feature; beta keeps mutations in VS Code's native trusted diff/SCM surfaces.
entries.proof_target: plugins/vscode/test/themeColors.test.ts::extension contributes Timeline, stage, and revert review surfaces

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff contributes a VS Code Timeline provider for review history and keeps compact review snapshots available through the extension history surface.
regression_tests: plugins/vscode/test/themeColors.test.ts::extension contributes Timeline, stage, and revert review surfaces
entries.next_action: Broaden timeline snapshots if review persistence needs richer historical metadata.
entries.proof_target: plugins/vscode/test/themeColors.test.ts::extension contributes Timeline, stage, and revert review surfaces

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff has a GitHub Action with sticky comments, job summary, JSON/SARIF/static HTML artifacts, path filtering, and guardrail annotations. PR URL entry and gist diff are convenience workflows outside the beta gate.
entries.next_action: Keep the GitHub Action/static artifact workflow as the primary CI path while the new PR URL and gist CLI helpers feed hosted-app style flows.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff ships a repo-hostable GitHub App MVP with webhook signature validation, pull request event parsing, deterministic check-run payloads, and mockable PR/gist URL CLI workflows.
entries.next_action: Add deployment packaging and real GitHub App registration only when hosting is selected.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff includes a Visual Studio 2022 VSIX scaffold with command identity and a thin command service that opens IntentumDiff review output through the CLI/static artifact surface.
entries.next_action: Turn the scaffold into a packaged VSIX after the command contract is validated against Visual Studio SDK builds.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff intentionally excludes JetBrains/IntelliJ from this pass; it remains the only deferred competitor surface.
entries.next_action: Revisit JetBrains/IntelliJ only after the non-IntelliJ beta surfaces are validated.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff includes an Electron-first standalone review shell with a shared renderer that can also build as a web companion and reads existing IntentumDiff artifact JSON.
entries.next_action: Package/sign installers only after the repo MVP renderer contract is validated.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff preserves relative paths for deleted files, dotted repo names, and multiple-extension filenames in changed-source collection.
entries.next_action: Keep old/new ref rendering in the normal release gate.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff has cross-file semantic analysis with package-path extract/split refactor proof for beta.
entries.next_action: Continue expanding multi-file grouped review intent after beta, with current cross-file move/split proof locked.

entries.intentumdiff_position: IntentumDiff custom diff exposes a hidden Unicode/control-character toggle that renders safe inline markers without changing raw source text.
regression_tests: plugins/vscode/test/reviewWebviewModel.test.ts::panel renders scope breadcrumbs and optional hidden Unicode markers
entries.next_action: Keep terminal/CLI hidden-character rendering as a separate post-beta polish item.
entries.proof_target: plugins/vscode/test/reviewWebviewModel.test.ts::panel renders scope breadcrumbs and optional hidden Unicode markers
